title: deep-audit report (v1)
description: Canonical contract for the /deep-audit-run report artifact (reviews/audit-report-<date>.json). The JSON IS the report; the .md view is derived from it. Verified-only (precision-first): a finding appears here ONLY after adversarial verify + adjudication promoted it. Coverage is driven off the execution ledger (DR-2), never off finding yield. A report is written ONLY on a fully completed run — any failed row suppresses the whole report and stops loudly (AC7), so a written report is always complete. reportVersion is pinned so the engine and the eventual differential (C-ledger) mode extend this contract only via an explicit version bump. All properties required (repo convention). The ledger states, the promote/refute adjudication, and the coverage derivation are defined in SKILL.md — not restated here.

generatedAt.description: ISO instant the report was written; its <YYYY-MM-DD>T<HHMMSS> form is the artifact filename key (same fail-closed collision guard as the plan — see SKILL.md).

target.description: Absolute path of the audited repo root.

planRef.description: Repo-relative path of the approved plan artifact this run executed.

source.description: The plan's source binding, echoed — the code state this run verified it still matched (by recomputing contentFingerprint) before executing (SKILL.md step 2). dirty MAY be true: a dirty plan is executable, verified via contentFingerprint (AR-1).

engineSlice.description: The lens@altitude pairs THIS engine build can execute (slice 1: ['hidden-failure@L1']). Plan rows outside this set are ledgered 'omitted' with reason 'lens not built in engine slice' and named in coverage.notCovered — honest slice scope, not a silent skip.

ledger.description: One entry PER PLAN ROW — the execution ledger (DR-2). notCovered is derived from this: only 'omitted' rows (plus out-of-slice altitudes/lenses) are uncovered; an 'executed' row with zero survivors is COVERED with a negative result.

state.description: 'executed' = ran to completion (survivors may be zero). 'omitted' = not run this slice (out-of-slice lens/altitude). 'failed' is never persisted — a failed row suppresses the whole report (AC7).

verifiedFindingCount.description: Post-verify survivors for this row; 0 on an executed row is a clean negative result, not a gap.

reason.description: Why omitted (e.g. 'lens not built in engine slice'), or null for an executed row.

findings.description: VERIFIED findings only — each promoted by adjudication (finder claim corroborated by claim-blind verifier evidence). Empty array is a valid, clean result. Provenance joins each back to its run + evidence.

findingId.description: Stable id the engine assigned (runId + index).

unitId.description: The plan unit ID this finding is in.

evidenceId.description: The evidence record that corroborated this finding (join to the verify stage).

runId.description: The run-manifest record that produced the finder finding.

pass.description: Which depth pass (1, or 2 on a deep row).

disposition.description: C-ledger stub (OPS-13): reserved for the future differential mode's durable disposition; always null in slice 1.

notCovered.description: Omitted rows + out-of-slice lenses/altitudes + L0 reserved. Derived from the ledger, never from finding yield.

assumptions.description: The pricing/execution constants actually used (echoed from the plan + any engine constants).

priorReportRef.description: C-ledger stub (OPS-13): the prior report a future differential re-audit would diff against; always null in slice 1.

status.description: A report exists only for a completed run; a failed row produces a loud stop and NO report (AC7).
